Esperinos ({{lang|grc|Ἑσπερινός}}): Glorification of God, the Creator of the world and its Providence
Apodepnon ({{lang|grc|Ἀπόδειπνον}}): Sleep as the image of death, illumined by Christ’s Harrowing of Hell after His death
Mesonyktikon ({{lang|grc|Μεσονυκτικόν}}): Christ’s midnight prayer in Gethsemane; a reminder to be ready for the Bridegroom coming at midnight and the Last Judgment
Orthros ({{lang|grc|Ὄρθρος}}): The Lord having given us not only daylight but spiritual light, Christ the Savior
Trite Ora ({{lang|grc|Τρίτη Ὥρα}}): Pilate's judgement of Christ and the descent of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost, which happened at this hour.
Ekte Ora ({{lang|grc|Ἕκτη Ὥρα}}): Christ's crucifixion, which happened at this hour
Ennate Ora ({{lang|grc|Ἐννάτη Ὥρα}}): Christ's death which happened at this hour.
